intents.text:
Rishabh built the [COVID-19 Decision Support System](/projects/covid-decision-support) as a BMSCE student project in a team of four between October 2022 and April 2023. 

- It is an **IoT-enabled, two-stage diagnostic pipeline** combining vitals, symptoms, and chest X-rays.
- Stage one provides a preliminary assessment from vitals and symptoms, while stage two adds chest X-ray analysis for a deeper diagnosis.
- A rule-based engine combines all inputs into a final report with recommended next steps.
- The project was awarded **6th place college-wide**.

- A Next.js gateway secures the backend by checking for bots, validating input, and rate-limiting visitors.
- It uses free model tiers across Groq, Gemini, Cloudflare, and OpenRouter with atomic Redis budgeting and automatic fallbacks.
- You can read more about it on the [How the AI agent on this site works](/blog/how-my-portfolio-agent-works) blog post.
